blocking.item: Rotation runbook revokes the old App keys (step 6) before restarting the daemon (step 7); the daemon holds the PEM in memory for its lifetime, so every pane's GitHub credential fails between the two steps and a failed step-7 boot has no rollback. Swap: restart on the new key, confirm `legion gh -- auth status` from a fresh worker pane, then revoke.

nonBlockingThreads.item: Soft wrap splits `base64-`/`decodes`, renders as 'base64- decodes'; fold the rewrap into the same push.
